en.headline: Wan Chai grill pop-up Marrow ends its run on Wednesday
en.dek: Chef Chris Ma’s meat-led pop-up at Lee Tung Avenue serves its last dinners on 30 September before the site returns to its usual occupant.
body: Marrow, a limited-run grill restaurant at Lee Tung Avenue in Wan Chai, will serve its last dinners on 30 September, the organisers said.

Chef Chris Ma opened the pop-up on 1 July in the first-floor space of The Baker and The Bottleman at 200 Queen’s Road East. After stronger-than-planned demand, the residency was extended from the original 31 August close through the end of September. Service is dinner only.

The menu has centred on open-fire cooking and lesser-known cuts, with dishes the kitchen has listed including typhoon-shelter roasted bone marrow, Sichuan beef tartare and Australian wagyu bavette. Five extra dishes using local seafood and regional flavours were added for September.
The Baker and The Bottleman has said it will later move to Leighton Road in Causeway Bay. Until Wednesday, Marrow continues at the Wan Chai address.

zh.headline: 灣仔利東街扒房快閃店Marrow周三結束
zh.dek: 主廚馬桂煄的肉類主題快閃店Marrow將於9月30日在利東街供應最後一晚晚餐。
body: 主辦單位表示，設於灣仔利東街的快閃扒房Marrow將於9月30日供應最後一晚晚餐。
主廚馬桂煄7月1日在皇后大道東200號The Baker and The Bottleman一樓開設此店，原定8月31日結束，其後因反應較預期好而延長至9月底，只開晚餐。
菜單以明火烹調及較少見的部位為主，店方曾列出避風塘燒骨髓、四川牛肉他他及澳洲和牛橫隘膜等菜式，9月再加入五款以本地海鮮及地區風味為題的新菜。
The Baker and The Bottleman表示稍後會遷往銅鑼灣禮頓道。在周三之前，Marrow仍在灣仔原址營業。
